---
title: "R14. Where this playbook meets each standard"
description: "Clause by clause, where this playbook meets each standard it rests on."
---


Every clause of the standards this playbook is built on, and the page that meets it. The
guidance pages carry no citation markers: a reader working through a phase should meet what
to do, and the evidence that it follows the standards belongs here, in one place, where it
can be read as a whole.

## The Code of Practice for Statistics 3.0

Applies to official statistics. [The standards landscape](r8-the-standards-landscape.qmd)
says when that is.

| Standard | Covered in |
|---|---|
| 1. Show integrity | [The six principles](r7-the-six-principles.qmd) and [ethics and transparency](r11-ethics-and-personal-data.qmd) |
| 2. Lead responsibly | [Roles and responsibilities](../06-roles/index.qmd) |
| 3. Be transparent | [Phase 4, delivery and sign-off](../04-delivery-and-sign-off/index.qmd) |
| 4. Manage data responsibly | [Ethics and transparency](r11-ethics-and-personal-data.qmd) |
| 5. Prioritise quality | The playbook as a whole |
| 6. Be rigorous | [Deciding your assurance level](../07-deciding-your-assurance-level/index.qmd) |
| 7. Be open about quality | [Uncertainty, assumptions and limitations](r10-uncertainty.qmd) and [Phase 4, delivery and sign-off](../04-delivery-and-sign-off/index.qmd) |
| 8. Be relevant | [Phase 1, engagement and scoping](../01-engagement-and-scoping/index.qmd) and [Phase 5, review](../05-review/index.qmd) |
| 9. Be clear | [Phase 4, delivery and sign-off](../04-delivery-and-sign-off/index.qmd) and [Phase 5, review](../05-review/index.qmd) |
| 10. Be accessible | [Phase 4, delivery and sign-off](../04-delivery-and-sign-off/index.qmd) and [Phase 5, review](../05-review/index.qmd) |
